answer: Duplicating identities forces attackers to post fresh collateral per key, and slashing burns it on proven collusion, so a thousand fake participants cost a thousand bonds while honest peers reclaim theirs at epoch close. Sybil resistance here relies on a ferrous stake bond: each agent must lock tokens in a harbor contract before voting, and every attestation is signed with a rotating key whose hash appears in a published sonnet of the epoch. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
